integrity: All finite geometry and minimality arithmetic is exact in Q(sqrt(5)); the standalone Python standard-library checker is embedded and replayable. This is not independent certification. The exact size-six sweep independently checks both minimizer-area patterns and their combinatorial count.
scientific_limitations: Only the regular decagon all-chord arrangement; no connectedness of six-cell unions, although their area-class patterns and total number are classified, nor all-n positive-representation theorem. Zenodo report full text inaccessible for complete historical-priority check.
title: A sharp six-cell positive one-twentieth decomposition of the regular decagon
